day_shape: 86 items: IDF strikes Tyre after multiple evacuation warnings following Hezbollah drone hit on Metula home, US-Iran deal talks dominate with Trump tying Abraham Accords to negotiations and Iran demanding $12bn Qatar-held assets released, heavy regime-channel messaging on 'no retreat'.

threads.label: IDF strikes Tyre after Hezbollah drones
threads.summary: The IDF issued multiple evacuation warnings for Tyre neighbourhoods (Al-Abbassiya, Al-Mashouk, North Tower, Al-Rashidiya) and began striking Hezbollah infrastructure in southern Lebanon late Monday. A Hezbollah drone struck a home roof in Metula causing damage but no injuries, with IDF Chief Zamir and Finance Minister Smotrich reportedly threatening Beirut strikes in retaliation.

threads.label: US-Iran deal negotiations and Abraham Accords
threads.summary: Trump posted on Truth Social that signing the Abraham Accords would be 'mandatory' for Muslim nations involved in Iran negotiations, while slamming critics of a rumoured 60-day ceasefire. Iran International reported Tehran is demanding release of $12 billion in frozen assets in Qatar as a precondition; Iran and US voiced optimism but tempered expectations.

threads.label: Israeli political reaction to Iran deal
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Netanyahu told confidants he has little influence over Trump on Iran, with Jerusalem Post citing two sources confirming the same. Opposition leader Lapid called the emerging US-Iran deal a 'disaster' and said Netanyahu failed to achieve victory.

threads.label: Regime 'no retreat' messaging cycle
threads.summary: The Supreme National Security Council secretary declared 'there will be no retreat', with IRGC commanders Hasanzadeh, Jahansahi, Sharif and Javani giving statements via Defa Press and IRIB claiming enemy defeat and military option permanently off the table. Pezeshkian said the negotiation process is designed so Iran's rights are fully realised and the country will not surrender to pressure.

threads.label: Regime claims on US war costs and losses
threads.summary: IRIB cited Financial Times that war with Iran has cost the US $270 billion, and claimed citing RT that Iran destroyed 30 MQ-9 Reaper drones — one-fifth of the US fleet, worth nearly $1 billion. Further IRIB items cited The Atlantic and CNN framing Trump's Iran policy as collapsing toward defeat.

threads.label: Qatar diplomacy and mediation track
threads.summary: Defa Press reported a delegation headed by Speaker Qalibaf travelled to Doha for consultations with senior Qatari officials, framed as continuation of a Pakistan-mediated process. Defa Press also cited Pakistan army chief Asim Munir telling Xi Jinping in Beijing that an Iran-US agreement has reached final stages.

threads.label: Qalibaf re-elected parliament speaker
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported Pezeshkian congratulated Qalibaf on his re-election as speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly. Judiciary head Mohseni Ezhei praised Qalibaf for fighting in the '12-day and Ramadan wars' in military and diplomatic fields.
